title: Splat Towers
description: A worm's-eye photograph of glass towers converging into a summer sky, lifted into about a hundred and fifty thousand real 3D Gaussians. From the original camera it is the photograph, exactly; drag and the camera swings a few degrees round the towers, so they part from each other and from a distant dome of cloud as real structure, and spring home when you let go. At the edges of the view the splats let go of the picture and show themselves as soft light. Developed like daylight negative film.
intent: herb asked for gaussian splats, 'reality in the computer'. Reference: herb's ref 2 (factory/reality/herb-refs/2-wormseye-skyscrapers.png), the worm's-eye shot of towers converging into cumulus; genre spec factory/reality/genre-spec.md. Splatting after Kerbl et al., 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering (https://repo-sam.inria.fr/fungraph/3d-gaussian-splatting/), with per-splat texture after Textured Gaussians (https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.18625).

sources.author: Davi Rezende (@davirezende)
sources.note: Toronto Financial District, iPhone 12 Pro. Depth from Depth Anything V2 Small (tools/depth/depth_hr.py); baked by tools/depth/bakes/splat-towers/bake.py into quantised splats (splats.bin) and a 2304x3072 texture (photo.webp).
